description: The Autonomous Province of Trento publishes a list of the public wastewater-treatment plants under its responsibility. The plant-management service provides JSON and XML versions of the site list through its telecontrol open-data service. Coverage is limited to the provincial responsibility stated in the source; it is not asserted to include every private or municipal plant. Access is free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. The plant inventory can provide facility inputs for wastewater-service capacity-planning studies. The brief metadata does not describe coordinates, treatment capacities, operating condition or time coverage, and no plant rows were downloaded to infer those fields. Publication and metadata-revision dates are not treated as plant observation dates. The related ISPAT treatment-plant indicator reports aggregated counts over territorial areas; this resource instead lists individual public plants. No direct crosswalk between the two is established by their descriptions.
